skill_name: Describe the stages of plant growth.
workflow: The stages of plant growth include seed germination, seedling establishment and growth, vegetative growth, flowering, reproduction, and fruit and seed production. During seed germination, the seed absorbs water which causes its embryo to start growing. During seedling establishment and growth, the emergence of the first leaves and root systems occurs.
